# The Main Zig Executable No Longer

The Main Zig Executable No Longer — a small useful developer tool

## Why
make the main zig executable no longer depend on LLVM, LLD, and Clang libraries. This issue is to fully eliminate LLVM, Clang, and LLD *libraries* from the Zig project. The remaining ties to these projects are as follows:
 * [ ] #8726
 * [ ] LLVM
   * [x] #13265
   * [x] C backend - 1742/1792 tests 

## Install / Run

```
python -m make_the_main_zig_eb4ee
```
